newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen lower, Nokia, paper still in focus.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen lower, Nokia, paper still in focus.

text.p: Shares were seen opening lower on Thursday after U.S. stocks fell overnight and Nokia ended on NYSE six markka below its Helsinki close, brokers said.
Forestries which rose sharply on Wednesday would also remain in focus, but correct lower in line with U.S. paper stocks which fell 0.33 percent.
A decline no sell-off was seen across the board.
"There will be a correction, but it will be thin," one broker said. Another expected shares to fall across the board, "but there will not be any sell-off," he said.
